expected.finding: **[P2]** `.github/workflows/revise-improvement-policy.yml`, existing-PR lookup: `gh pr list --head "$branch"` matches the branch name without verifying its source repository. A fork PR named `improvement-policy-proposal` can therefore be selected. The workflow then posts its regeneration comment on that unrelated PR and exits successfully, leaving the actual generated proposal without a PR. Filter by the head repository and expected base branch before selecting a result. The [CLI documentation](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_pr_list) confirms that `--head` filters by branch name without owner qualification.
